# TaxVett

> TaxVett is a REST API that validates tax numbers in one call: EU VAT for all 27 member states (live VIES lookup), Australian ABN (live ABR), Norwegian organisation numbers (live Brønnøysundregisteret), and UK VAT and Singapore GST/UEN (format and checksum). It returns validity plus the registered company name and address where the registry provides them. Typical use: checking B2B customers' VAT numbers at checkout or on invoices (EU reverse charge).

- Free plan: 500 requests/month, no credit card. Paid plans from €9/month.
- Full API reference for LLMs: https://api.taxvett.com/llms.txt
- OpenAPI: https://api.taxvett.com/openapi.json
- SDKs: `npm install taxvett` (Node.js/TypeScript), `pip install taxvett` (Python)
- Interactive docs: https://api.taxvett.com/docs
- Sign up: https://taxvett.com/signup
- Pricing: https://taxvett.com/#pricing
